item.title: Acme Weather is an upgraded Dark Sky reboot that knows your weather app sucks, coming to Android
item.description: If there’s one thing we all agree on, it’s that weather apps almost universally kind of suck. You’re often stuck choosing between a nice design and an accurate forecast. Now, “Acme Weather” is confirmed for a launch on Android, and it’s a reboot of the popular Dark Sky app that embraces the inherent uncertainty of forecasting. more…
